notes: Printed Characteristics, Wounds and attack Damage are the starting baseline. Fifth Edition core rules apply to shared Traits.

traits.name: Vicious Webs
traits.text: A target entangled by the Arachnarok’s webs also gains a Poisoned Condition.

traits.name: Borrowed Courage
traits.text: Away from the tribe, scouts or raiders typically ride giant spiders in groups of 3 to 10. Mounted Forest Goblins ignore Afraid (Elves).

traits.name: Strength of the Pack
traits.text: Fourth Edition reference. When the pack outnumbers a foe, the wolves add a further +10 to their outnumbering modifier.

traits.name: Piercing Cry
traits.text: When charging, spend 2 Momentum to screech as a Free Attack. Opponents within Toughness Bonus yards make a Hard (−2 SL) Willpower Test or gain one Stunned Condition.

traits.name: Burrow 30
traits.text: As its Move, tunnel up to 30 yards through earth and stone, ignoring terrain, obstacles and characters. It can Charge and choose whether to emerge. If it starts underground, it must use Burrow for its Move. Against it, measure horizontal distance and increase range by two steps.

traits.name: Swallow Whole
traits.text: After a maw attack critically hits or deals Wounds of twice the target’s TB to a target its Size or smaller, oppose Strength. A win inflicts Entangled, plus another for each 2 SL of margin. The victim’s next Action must be an Opposed Strength Test to escape. If still Entangled, they take 10 Wounds, reduced by TB and AP, and are swallowed. Inside, they stay Entangled and suffer 10 Wounds per Round ignoring AP. After a Willpower Test to act, an unopposed Melee Test with a Very Short or Personal weapon gains +20. Deal 20 cumulative Wounds ignoring its Armour to escape.

traits.name: Too Ornery to Die
traits.text: Ignore the effects of the first Critical Hit suffered in each combat.

traits.name: The Forest Is My Shield
traits.text: In woodland among trees, it cannot be outnumbered. Ranged attacks against it suffer −20. If that penalty turns an otherwise successful shot into a miss, the GM randomly determines which nearby tree or engaged foe the shot hits.

traits.name: A Wyvern’s Spite
traits.text: A foe surprised by the Wyvern must pass a Willpower Test or suffer −10 to all Tests and lose access to Fortune until the Wyvern dies or the foe loses 5 or more Wounds.

traits.name: I Am Unstoppable
traits.text: A mounted Skaven rider gains Immunity to Psychology. If the Bonebreaker dies, the rider gains 5 Broken Conditions and other Skaven within 10 yards gain 1.

traits.name: Engulf
traits.text: On a hit against a target of its Size or smaller, the amoeba may engulf one victim, inflicting Entangled Conditions equal to its SB. The victim loses SB Wounds each Round ignoring TB and AP. The amoeba cannot attack the victim, but any attack that hits the amoeba also hits the victim. It withdraws to digest if the victim dies or stops struggling.

traits.name: Jelly from Hell
traits.text: Halve Wounds from sources other than fire, extreme cold or magic, rounding down. Only these exceptions usually kill it permanently.

traits.name: Mostly Mindless
traits.text: It cannot test Intelligence, Willpower or Fellowship. Substitute its Strength Bonus for Willpower Bonus. It will not approach open flame and gains Broken if approached with it.

traits.name: Four-Fold Knowing Gaze
traits.text: It cannot be surprised and it takes at least four opponents to outnumber it. Once each Round it can reverse one of its Combat Tests.

traits.name: Rotten Stench
traits.text: Living targets within Toughness Bonus yards suffer −10 to all Tests. Multiple Rotten Stenches do not stack.

traits.name: Overwhelming Stench
traits.text: Living targets within Toughness Bonus yards suffer −10 to all Tests. Multiple stenches do not stack. On first exposure, test Willpower or gain a Stunned Condition.

traits.name: Hallucinogenic Cloud
traits.text: Mammals within TB yards make a Hard (−2 SL) Toughness Test. Success protects against this leech for a day. Failure leaves them effectively Unconscious for 3 Rounds plus one per SL of failure.

traits.name: Endless Coils
traits.text: It may grapple up to five smaller targets at once.

traits.name: Endless Malice
traits.text: After killing or incapacitating a living foe, test Willpower or spend its next Action and Move mauling the victim. An unconscious victim suffers a Critical Wound. Witnesses are subject to Fear 2.

traits.name: We See You
traits.text: A Chimera cannot be surprised or outnumbered in combat.

traits.name: Endless Rage
traits.text: The Skin Wolf is always Frenzied.

traits.name: Blazing Body
traits.text: At the end of each Round, all engaged targets take 1d10 Wounds reduced by TB and AP, to a minimum of 1. Against non-magical attacks, the Great Taurus uses double its TB.

traits.name: Bloodrage
traits.text: The Great Taurus is always Frenzied and hates all opponents.

traits.name: Vibrational Senses
traits.text: It detects all physical creatures within four times its Initiative Bonus in yards and cannot be Surprised.

traits.name: Unstoppable Charge (Imperial Zoo)
traits.text: The Stegadon gains 3 Momentum when it charges.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy (Imperial Zoo)
traits.text: After inflicting a Wound in combat, it is Frenzied until all foes it can sense are dead.

traits.name: Disruption
traits.text: Fourth Edition reference. Unstable creatures in its presence count as having 2 less Advantage when resolving Unstable at the end of the Round, without spending or losing any.

traits.name: Crustacean
traits.text: Can breathe underwater and has Movement 8 in water.

traits.name: Siren’s Song
traits.text: A listener makes a Difficult (−1 SL) Willpower Test or can only move toward the singer, effectively Unconscious but awake. Plugging the ears makes the Test Easy (+4 SL). A victim may test again when attacked.

traits.name: Water Born
traits.text: Can breathe underwater and has Movement 8 in water.

traits.name: Rabid Frenzy
traits.text: When wounded in combat, it enters an unbreakable Frenzy granting two free Melee Tests per Round.

traits.name: Razor Scales
traits.text: An engaged opponent that attacks it takes 1d10 Wounds reduced by TB and AP, to a minimum of 1.

traits.name: Fury (Imperial Zoo)
traits.text: Spend 1 Momentum to hate opponents in close combat. Spend 3 Momentum to become Frenzied and then lose any remaining Momentum.
